newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Midwest direct hogs seen steady-lower Tuesday.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Midwest direct hogs seen steady-lower Tuesday.

text.p: U.S. Midwest direct cash hogs were expected to sell at prices steady to $0.50 per cwt lower on Tuesday, with weakness linked to the announced cutbacks at IBP Inc's six pork plants, livestock dealers said.
"I'm hearing steady outside of IBP," one Illinois dealer said, noting the weakness would be centered on areas where IBP was a major buyer.
IBP announced Monday it was cutting back production at its plants in Waterloo, Storm Lake, Perry and Columbus Junction, all in Iowa, as well as Madison, Neb. and Logansport, Ind.
A pickup in hog movement was also forecast.
